versionScope.description: Which packages share a version. one-for-stream: Every package in the release group gets the same version. per-package: Each package gets its own version. none: The release group carries no version.

companionModules.description: Go modules whose version tag is pushed on the release commit together with the stream tag, such as go/v1.2.3 beside cli-v1.2.3. Each module keeps its own stream.

needsJobs.description: Jobs of an observed operation in needs that must succeed before this operation starts, keyed by that operation

existingTriggers.description: What happens to the existing triggers of a workflow Beepboop runs. keep-and-report: The workflow keeps its existing triggers. Beepboop reports a trigger that conflicts with its dispatch. replace-with-dispatch: Beepboop replaces the workflow's existing triggers with its own dispatch. keep-and-block-conflicts: The workflow keeps its existing triggers. Beepboop blocks the setup when a trigger cannot work with its dispatch.

versionLands.description: How a new version reaches the default branch. via-version-pr: Beepboop opens a version PR, and merging it puts the new version on the default branch. via-direct-commit: Beepboop pushes a signed commit with the new version straight to the default branch.

versionPrMerge.description: Who merges the version PR. manual: You merge the version PR yourself. squash: Beepboop turns on GitHub auto-merge, and GitHub squashes the version PR into one commit once its checks pass. With `publishWhen: version-pr-merged`, the release then publishes with nobody touching it. merge: Beepboop turns on GitHub auto-merge, and GitHub merges the version PR with a merge commit once its checks pass. With `publishWhen: version-pr-merged`, the release then publishes with nobody touching it. rebase: Beepboop turns on GitHub auto-merge, and GitHub rebases the version PR onto the default branch once its checks pass. With `publishWhen: version-pr-merged`, the release then publishes with nobody touching it.

publishWhen.description: When a version on the default branch publishes. approved-in-beepboop: You publish it: the Publish button in Beepboop or `beepboop runs publish`. Approving or merging the version PR on GitHub does not publish. version-pr-merged: Merging the version PR publishes it once the checks pass. Nobody publishes it in Beepboop. version-commit-pushed: A signed commit that raises the version publishes it once the checks pass, with no review.

versionBump.description: Earlier name of versionLands: commit pushes a signed bot commit to the default branch, pr opens a version PR.
